posts.post:
the bar for how men dress in india is so low that a plain white tee makes you 'the fashion guy'.

we need to talk about that.

oversized hoodie or structured jacket.

there's no middle ground for a Friday night.

some guys just always look put together without trying.

it's never the logo.

we spent six months obsessing over the weight of our cotton so you don't have to.

check the heavyweights at strayed.in
